name: Jetpack
description: The Create Jetpack is a backtank you can fly with.

pages.title: Jetpack
pages.text: The Create Jetpack is a backtank you can fly with. It is built around a [#](2E5AAC)[Copper Backtank](entry://ocean/diving)[#]() and spends pressurised air to lift you, so it runs dry and needs refilling.

pages.title: Jetpack
pages.text: Jump rises, sneak descends, N switches the engine on or off (this pack's key; the mod's own is G), H toggles hover. Rebind in Controls.

pages.title: Netherite Jetpack
pages.text: The same flight, built around a Netherite Backtank. Check JEI for the upgrade recipe.

pages.title: Making one
pages.text:
Both versions are crafted by [#](7A3C9A)[mechanical crafting](entry://glossary/mechanical_crafting)[#]() from a Shulker Shell, Chutes, Brass plates, Precision Mechanisms and the backtank. Press R over one in [#](2E5AAC)[JEI](entry://start_here/tools)[#]() to see the layout.\
\
For something larger than one person, see [#](2E5AAC)[Airships](entry://flight/airships)[#]().
